observation: Nozzle extensions slowed air too much; it warmed before reaching useful distance.
goal_retained: Local cooling on a person at about 20 cm
interpretation: Qualitative failure of useful cooling. Air warming, mass-flow loss and the dominant mechanism remain unmeasured.
decision: Do not repeat the entire extension set. Instrument bare outlet and one representative failed extension first.
